prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Generate a NEW transparent 3-column by 2-row sheet of six COMPLETE standing gaze/gesture poses. Image 1 (approved standing character) is the STRICT anatomy and proportion reference, image 2 only specifies the six gaze/gesture ideas and MUST NOT supply its oversized-head/short-body proportions, image 3 is the same approved front identity. The user rejected image 2 because its mushroom hat/head are about 30 percent too wide and its torso/legs too short. Correct ALL SIX figures to the exact head, cap, face, torso, skirt, leg and boot proportions of image 1. NOT an extra-chibi doll: do NOT enlarge the head or reduce the body again. Each equal 512px cell: same full-figure height as image 1, cap top about y40, soles about y472, berry clasp about y309, clasp-to-sole length about 162px; red cap width about 227px, NOT 290-310px. Keep the face same size as image 1 and a visible short but properly proportioned torso/skirt and legs. Neck/shoulders around y295-310, not down at y350. These coordinates are composition targets, no printed guides or numbers. Whole pose is drawn naturally; no cut-and-paste or separately scaled head. Preserve exact girl identity, brown eyes/bob hair, red spotted mushroom cap, olive cape/red berry clasp, ivory petal dress, brown boots and painterly 3D storybook style. Six poses left-to-right then next row: (1) three-quarter facing LEFT, eyes gaze up-left, mild lifted chin and one open hand raised curiously; (2) three-quarter facing LEFT, eyes left at level, one forearm extended open hand; (3) three-quarter facing LEFT, HEAD ONLY nods slightly down with pupils down-left, body stays standing with same leg/torso lengths, soft open hands, no squat or bent knees; (4) nearly frontal pupils up-left, subtle hand near chest; (5) nearly frontal pupils up-right, hand near chest; (6) frontal pupils up toward an invisible light above, both hands gently open. BOTH eyes visible in all figures, warm small curious smiles, no exaggerated big open mouth. Keep standing body size and boots consistent across all six; only gaze, slight head direction and arm gestures change. Plain genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha background, no orb, floor, scenery, shadows, labels, borders, watermark or duplicates. Ample margins, complete uncut caps/hands/boots. The approved reference 1 proportions take precedence over any generic chibi style.
